answer: At t+0, newcomers deposit a 1-pigment bond in an ocean of trust. They solve a cipher at registration, proving their identity. At epoch close, verifiers cross-reference identities with beacon checks. A missed verification incurs a 10% penalty, forfeiting the entire epoch's emission. Mass cloning costs 50 pigments per cloned node, but rewards are only 45 pigments per epoch, leading to a net loss of 5 pigments per cloned node.
